retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style music album layout featuring a studio portrait against a warm gradient background with a distinctive corner sash and high-contrast serif display type.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant red-to-peach gradient background serves as the stage for a three-quarter length studio portrait of a female vocalist. The composition is anchored by a bold diagonal yellow sash in the bottom-left corner and large-scale, high-contrast serif typography in the top-left.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's vertical posture balances the heavy diagonal sash in the opposite corner.
The white typography echoes the white skirt of the subject, creating a visual diagonal link.
The warm red background provides a high-contrast field for the cool black hair and white clothing.
coreInvariants: Warm red-to-orange radial or linear gradient background
Diagonal sash graphic in the bottom-left corner
Large-scale serif display text in the top-left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, scaled to show from the head to the mid-calf.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white serif text in the top-left corner acts as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left text, down the subject's body, to the diagonal sash in the bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the center-left allows the gradient background to create a sense of depth and atmosphere.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value (brightness) in the foreground elements for maximum legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical stems with very thin horizontal hairlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a cohesive word-block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with a casual script for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Diagonal yellow sash with black borders in the bottom-left corner
Small rectangular logo box in the bottom-left

preserve: Diagonal orientation of the sash text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century transitional serif aesthetic
Provides the necessary high contrast for a display look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a person in 1960s attire against a vibrant red-to-orange gradient background. Include a yellow diagonal sash in the bottom-left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large white serif text in the top-left corner and a black script font along the diagonal of the yellow sash.

verificationChecks: Is the background a warm red gradient?
Is the main text a high-contrast serif?
Is there a diagonal yellow sash in the bottom-left?
Is the subject positioned on the right side?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the diagonal sash is at a 45-degree angle
Ensure the serif type is bold and legible
Confirm the red gradient is smooth and vibrant
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Portrait + Red Gradient + Corner Sash + Serif Display Type
